name: Ringer 3D 🔮 Marble Duels
description:
Flick your shooter, knock marbles out of the ring, keep what you capture!

🎯 Classic Ringer: 13 marbles in a cross. Knock one out and stay inside the ring to shoot again.
⚔️ Duel players on your server, practise against 8 bot levels, or climb THE TOWER: eight floors on six fields up to the Black Taw.
🔮 Collect marbles: Ember, Volt, Nova, Obsidian and more. LIMITED marbles carry serial numbers: only 500 Auroras will ever exist!
🎒 Marble Bags with every drop rate shown in the shop.
🏆 Global leaderboard, badges and a daily reward streak.
👑 VIP: double coins, the Golden Taw and a VIP chat tag. Roblox Premium members get the Prism marble and +25% coins.

🕹️ Controls: press, pull back and let go. Works on phone, tablet and PC.

New fields and marbles every update. Favourite ⭐ to get them first!
